body.prompt: Black and white cinematic film look, soft grain. Locked-off tripod camera: no zoom, no pan, no tilt. A wide shot from a 45-degree angle of a library study at night: a man in a navy suit sits at a dark wooden desk, a black broadcast microphone on a boom arm, a brass desk lamp casting a warm pool of light on his folded hands and the desk. His head and face are outside the top of the frame the entire time; we only see from the shoulders down. He stays almost still, hands resting calmly, subtle breathing only. Tall bookshelves in soft focus behind. No text, no logos.
